NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Add 'Give Kudos' button to 'Group Activity'
patches.description: Adds a button that triggers the same action as shaking your phone would.

patches.name: Add activity export
patches.description: Adds an "Export GPX" item to the activity overflow menu, which saves the activity's GPS track as a GPX file in Downloads/Strava.

patches.name: Add media download
patches.description: Extends the full-screen media viewer menu with items to copy or open their URLs or download them directly.

patches.name: Add route export
patches.description: Allows exporting and downloading Strava routes as GPX or TCX files directly from the app.

patches.name: Always allow deep-linking
patches.description: Open Amazon links, even if the app is not set to handle Amazon links.

patches.name: Auto claim channel points
patches.description: Automatically claim Channel Points.

patches.name: Block Snowplow tracking
patches.description: Blocks Snowplow analytics. See https://snowplow.io for more information.

patches.name: Block audio ads
patches.description: Blocks audio ads in streams and VODs.

patches.name: Block embedded ads
patches.description: Blocks embedded stream ads using services like Luminous or PurpleAdBlocker.

patches.name: Block video ads
patches.description: Blocks video ads in streams and VODs.

patches.name: Bypass login
patches.description: Allows the use of the app after its discontinuation.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Appends ".morphe" to the package name by default. Changing the package name of the app can lead to unexpected issues. This patch does not work with Reddit.

options.title: Package name
options.description: The name of the package to rename the app to.

options.title: Update permissions
options.description: Update compatibility receiver permissions. Enabling this can fix installation errors, but this can also break features in certain apps.

options.title: Update providers
options.description: Update provider names declared by the app. Enabling this can fix installation errors, but this can also break features in certain apps.

patches.name: Debug mode
patches.description: Enables Twitch's internal debugging mode.

patches.name: Disable Quick Edit
patches.description: Prevents the Quick Edit prompt from popping up.

patches.name: Disable typing indicator
patches.description: Disables the indicator while typing a message.

patches.name: Enable DCIM folders backup control
patches.description: Disables always on backup for the Camera and other DCIM folders, allowing you to control backup for each folder individually. This will make the app default to having no folders backed up.

patches.name: Enable password login
patches.description: Re-enables password login after having used an OTP code.

patches.name: Fix selected account persistence
patches.description: Prevents Google Photos from clearing the selected account after cold start when using MicroG.

patches.name: Force enable FreePhone
patches.description: Enables the FreePhone menu in the navigation drawer even on devices that do not support eSIM.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches.name: Hide Ads
patches.description: Hides ad banners between chats.

patches.name: Hide Facebook buttons
patches.description: Hides buttons and shortcuts that open Facebook.

patches.name: Hide OneDrive migration
patches.description: Hides the OneDrive migration prompt when opening Microsoft Office Lens.

patches.name: Hide Premium upgrade button
patches.description: Hides the Premium upgrade button in the navigation drawer.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored ads.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hide ads and sponsored articles in list pages and remove pre-roll ads on videos.

patches.name: Hide distractions
patches.description: Hides elements that are not essential.

options.title: Promotions
options.description: Elements that promote features, challenges, clubs, etc.

options.title: Who to Follow
options.description: Popular athletes, followers, people near you etc.

options.title: Suggested Challenges
options.description: Random challenges Strava wants you to join.

options.title: Activity lookback
options.description: Your activity from X years ago

patches.name: Hide inbox ads
patches.description: Hides ads in inbox.

patches.name: Hide inbox stories and notes tray
patches.description: Hides the stories and notes horizontal tray at the top of the inbox.

patches.name: Hide inbox subtabs
patches.description: Hides Home and Channels tabs between active now tray and chats.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Permanently hides navigation bar buttons, such as Explore and Marketplace.

patches.name: Hide story ads
patches.description: Hides the ads in the Facebook app stories.

patches.name: Hide update popup
patches.description: Prevents the update popup from showing up.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Always opens links in your default browser instead of the in-app browser, regardless of the in-app setting.

patches.name: Overwrite media upload parameters
patches.description: Overwrites the compression, resize and trim media (images and videos) parameters returned by Strava's server before upload.

options.title: Compression quality (percent)
options.description: This is used as the JPEG quality setting (≤ 100).

options.title: Max duration (seconds)
options.description: The maximum length (≤ 3600) of a video before it gets trimmed.

options.title: Max size (pixels)
options.description: The image gets resized so that the smaller dimension (width/height) does not exceed this value (≤ 10000).

patches.name: Prevent log upload
patches.description: Avoid uploading logs when the application crashes.

patches.name: Remove Meta AI
patches.description: Removes UI elements related to Meta AI.

patches.name: Remove device restrictions
patches.description: Removes restrictions from using the app on any device. Requires mounting patched app over original.

patches.name: Remove play limits
patches.description: Disables purchase nagging and playback limits of not purchased tracks.

patches.name: Remove popular search time limit
patches.description: Removes the 7-day trial countdown on popular search results so the free popular-search preview (30 works) never expires.

patches.name: Rename shared permissions
patches.description: Rename certain permissions shared across Amazon apps. Applying this patch can fix installation errors, but can also break features in certain apps.

patches.name: Show K1 token(s)
patches.description: Shows the K1 authentication token(s) in a dialog and logs it to logcat for pairing with GadgetBridge without requiring root access.

patches.name: Show deleted messages
patches.description: Shows deleted chat messages behind a clickable spoiler.

patches.name: Skip ads
patches.description: Skip ads between the tracks.

patches.name: Spoof certificate
patches.description: Spoofs the X-Android-Cert header to allow push messages.

patches.name: Spoof device ID
patches.description: Spoofs device ID to mitigate manual bans by developers.

patches.name: Spoof features
patches.description: Spoofs the device to enable Google Pixel exclusive features, including unlimited storage.

options.title: Features to enable
options.description: Google Pixel exclusive features to enable. Features up to Pixel XL enable the unlimited storage feature.

options.title: Features to disable
options.description: Google Pixel exclusive features to disable.Features after Pixel XL may have to be disabled for unlimited storage depending on the device.

patches.name: Spoof package version
patches.description: Sets a very high version code so the Play Store treats the app as already up to date and never offers an update.

options.title: Version code
options.description: The version code to set. Must be higher than the Play Store version to suppress updates. Defaults to the maximum value.

patches.name: Unlimited track skipping
patches.description: Unlocks the ability to skip tracks without restriction.

patches.name: Unlock Unlimited
patches.description: Unlock Music Unlimited features.

patches.name: Unlock subscription features
patches.description: Unlocks "Routes", "Matched Runs" and "Segment Efforts".
